title: Uniform Correction Terms for a Shared AES S-Box
summary: In the examined shared AES S-box, correction terms cancel under linear mixing, causing nonuniformity and recoverable first-order leakage; a uniform combination remains unknown.

formal_statement.body: Consider the shared AES S-box design in which outputs of shared multiplication modules over $\mathrm{GF}(2^2)$ having some shared inputs are combined by linear functions. In the examined design, correction terms added to the shared multiplications to provide uniformity cancel during this linear mixing, so the S-box outputs are not uniformly distributed and glitch-induced combinational-circuit leakage yields recoverable first-order leakage. Determine whether any choice and combination of correction terms avoids this cancellation and makes the resulting distribution uniform; if such a choice exists, construct it. The prior search neither exhausted all possible combinations nor found a suitable one.

scope.domain: Side-channel-resistant shared AES S-box design using linearly combined outputs of shared finite-field multiplication modules.
assumptions: Some shared multiplication modules have shared inputs, and linear functions combine their outputs.
parameters: GF(2²): the field used by the shared multiplication modules
Correction-term choice and combination: the design variables intended to provide uniformity
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether a correction-term choice and combination can avoid cancellation and yield a uniform distribution, and construct one if it exists.

citations.label: Pushing the Limits: A Very Compact and a Threshold Implementation of AES

progress.summary: The source reports cancellation, nonuniform outputs, and recoverable first-order glitch leakage in the examined design. It found no suitable correction-term combination but did not exhaust the search.
citation_labels: Amir Moradi et al., Pushing the Limits: A Very Compact and a Threshold Implementation of AES
